entries.cherry_courageofthecolossus_summary: Gain @TotalShield@ Shield after Immobilizing or Grounding an enemy champion.
entries.cherry_jeweledgauntlet_summary:
Your Abilities can Critically Strike.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% @CritGranted@ Crit Chance.
entries.kiwi_augment_totentanz_description:
Replace a Summoner Spell with {{Kiwi_Augment_Totentanz_Summoner_Name}}.

{{Kiwi_Augment_Totentanz_Summoner_Name}}: Blink forward and become Unkillable. Get a takedown within @Buff_Duration@ seconds or else
YOU DIE.
entries.kiwi_doubletap_summary:
Your Critical Strikes apply %i:OnHit% On-Hit effects an additional time.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% @Calc_Crit_Chance@ Crit chance.
entries.kiwi_littleextrahelp_summary: Gain @RangeIncrease@ Attack Range and @ExtraAttackSpeed@ <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> during your {{SpellName}} duration.
entries.kiwi_proteinshake_summary: Gain <healing>%i:scaleHealShield%@BonusHSPower@% Heal and Shield Power</healing> based on bonus <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.
entries.kiwi_titanspulse_summary: When {{Spellname}} damages enemy champions, gain @ARMR_Inc@ <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resistance</scaleMR>.
entries.kiwi_twinfire_summary:
On ability damage, fire 1 plus @AdditionalMis@ missiles that deal @Damage@ magic damage each.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% @CrtiChance*100@% Critical Strike Chance.
